snippet.title: BLOOD MALL - Trailer | Indie PSX Horror Slasher, VHS Style
snippet.description:
https://olliehall.itch.io/blood-mall

"MASSACRE AT DAYTON COUNTY MALL! HUNDREDS DEAD, OVER 350 INJURED. EXPERTS ARE STILL INVESTIGATING WHAT EXACTLY HAPPENED, BUT IT APPEARS A... DINOSAUR?... MATERIALISED IN THE MALL AND WENT FERAL."

BLOOD MALL is a short action horror game where you play as a big game hunter turned rookie cop, hunting down a terrifyingly wicked dinosaur that inexplicably appeared in a busy shopping mall.
Place the bait, lure the creature in, and aim like your life depends on it.

Listen to the soundtrack here: youtu.be/RFQn8ecM6xA
